crossRefs.note: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

translations.web: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
translations.bsb: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
translations.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath ➔ not grieved me, but in part: that ➔ I may ➔ not overcharge you all.
translations.asv: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.
